scripts.build: echo && echo \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* running build: build_alpha build_admin build_html build_js \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* && npm run build_alpha && npm run build_admin && npm run build_html && npm run build_js && npm run pages && echo installed version $npm_package_name-$npm_package_version && V=$(npm pkg get version --workspaces=false | tr -d '"') && echo $V >.build && CSSVERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').config.cssversion") && echo "package version is $(cat .build)-$CSSVERSION"
scripts.refresh: rm -rf node_modules && npm install && npm run build
